Synacor ran three sale efforts: a 2018 effort begun by private investment firm Company A, which withdrew in June 2018 while Liontree contacted about 12 parties, and a 2019 effort around Company C’s cash-and-stock letter of intent, during which Canaccord contacted 18 more parties. Between and after them, Synacor held merger-of-equals talks with Company B and signed, then terminated, an all-stock merger with Company D, while partial bidders Company F and later Company I sought only the portal and advertising business. In 2020 Canaccord contacted 37 parties and 14 signed NDAs; by the 09/17/2020 deadline Company E had offered $2.00 per share in cash with a rollover by 180 Degree, CLP $1.35 to $1.41, and Company G bid only for the software and services business. Synacor gave Company E exclusivity until 10/23/2020, renewed outreach after it lapsed, and on 12/14/2020 Company E switched to a 35% tender offer proposal that the Special Committee let expire. CLP re-engaged in December, offered $1.88 on 01/04/2021 and $2.00 after price feedback, and Synacor signed its letter of intent on 01/07/2021 and negotiated with it alone, while Company H never submitted a proposal. After the Board asked for $2.20, CLP raised its price on 02/10/2021 in exchange for a $3.5 million termination fee and same-day signing, and the deal was announced on 02/11/2021.
